intent.desired_action: Look inside the Your Plans on Paper Softback Spiral Productivity Planner to decide whether its planning structure suits a focused client project.

events.preview_text: Organise 16 undated weeks with goal breakdowns and three planning views.
events.body:
Map a substantial client project across 16 weeks on paper.

Papier’s Your Plans on Paper Softback Spiral Productivity Planner gives freelance work a bounded structure: 16 weeks of undated planning pages, supported by goal breakdowns.

Start with the project goal, then organise the work through monthly, weekly and daily planning pages. Each view offers a different planning cadence while keeping the project on paper.

Because the pages are undated, you choose where the 16-week plan begins.

Open the product page’s Look inside view to review the goal-planning space and monthly, weekly and daily layouts, then decide whether the structure suits your client-project workflow.

events.message: Email 1, draft 1: "Review a project across 16 weeks"
events.subject: Review a project across 16 weeks
events.preview_text: Plan the work on paper, then reflect on progress and working patterns.
events.body:
Papier’s productivity planner gives a focused client project a **16-week undated structure** on paper. Goal breakdowns help shape the plan, while reflections provide a place to keep track of progress as the work develops.

The planner also includes accountability tracking tools and articles intended to help you understand your working patterns. Together, they make reviewing the project part of the planning process—not simply something left until the end.

For a closer view of the planning rhythm, the Your Plans on Paper edition includes monthly, weekly and daily pages. You can move between the wider project, the week ahead and the work for today, away from a screen.

Explore the range to see how Papier combines planning, progress reflection and accountability support for a focused project.

events.body:
One client project can take shape at more than one level.

Your Plans on Paper is Papier’s softback spiral productivity planner, with goal breakdowns and 16 weeks of undated pages. It gives a focused freelance project a clear paper framework, from the overall goal to the work being planned.

Its monthly, weekly and daily planning pages let you organise the same project at each of those levels. Because the 16-week format is undated, you can choose where your plan begins.

The product page’s Look inside view shows the goal-planning space and the monthly, weekly and daily layouts. Flick through them to judge whether the structure offers the room and continuity your client-project workflow needs.
